newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LDP calls for bank debenture protection-Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Japan LDP calls for bank debenture protection-Jiji.

text.p: A senior official of Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) said on Monday that discount bank debentures with one-year maturities held by individual investors should be protected in the same way as bank deposits, Jiji news agency reported.

"I think discount bank debentures with maturities of one year held by individual investors should be treated equally with deposits, which are to be protected for five years," Taku Yamasaki, chairman of LDP's Policy Research Council, was quoted by Jiji as saying.
Yamasaki was also quoted as saying that the Finance Ministry should not try to balance a fall in tax revenues if the securities transaction tax is cut, with a rise in capital gains tax.
Japan should also make an effort to set a timetable to implement reductions in corporate taxes, Yamasaki said.
The Finance Ministry should not try to balance cuts in corporate taxes by other means either, he was quoted as saying.
